notes.subject: nisebɛn
notes.rationale: קרץ occurs only here in the Tanakh; JPS 'gadfly' from Aramaic 'to pinch', KJV 'destruction' from a cognate root

notes.subject: קרץ
notes.rationale: 'gadfly' (a stinging insect, JPS) vs 'destruction/extirpation' (KJV, Geneva) — the word's very rarity is the crux

notes.subject: בא בא
notes.rationale: the verb 'come' is doubled for dread-emphasis; Bambara keeps the doubling 'o bɛ na, o bɛ na'

notes.subject: כלי גולה v19 / misidenmuso v20
notes.rationale: the heifer image continues: beautiful but defenseless, the stinging fly comes from the north

translation: Mitsrayim (Misira) ye misidenmuso finankan ye; nisebɛn min bɛ saheli fɛ, o bɛ na, o bɛ na.
